rows.title: Address Change
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding change in Registered Office of the Company.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizer's report of Annual General Meeting held on 31 July 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of 81st Annual General Meeting held on 31 July 2026

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended 30 June 2026.

rows.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding 81st Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on Friday, 31 July 2026 and e-voting Information.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of 81st Annual General Meeting to be held on 31 July 2026 through VC facility / OAVM.

rows.title: Trading Window
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper Publication w.r.t. 81st Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held through Video Conferencing/Other Audio-Visual Means

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''Communication sent to shareholders regarding Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) on final dividend and updation of bank account details''.

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding, the Annual General Meeting of the Company, which is scheduled to be held on Friday, 31 July 2026. Further details will be provided in due course.'.

rows.title: Change in Management
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange about reappointment of Dr. Arindam Bhattacharya as a Non-Executive, Independent Director of the Company for second term of five consecutive years.

rows.title: Record Date
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Final Dividend is 30 June 2026

rows.title: Dividend
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange that, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 7 May 2026, recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 130 per equity share, subject to the approval of  shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the exchange regarding approval of financial results along with the Audit Report for the financial year ended 31 March 2026

rows.title: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
rows.summary: Niraj Bajaj has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of equity shares of Bajaj Finserv Limited, an associate of the Company, from Bajaj Auto Holdings Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, through a block deal mechanism
